title: [Performance][DSpark] Merge DeepSeek V4.1 context WKV projections and reuse RoPE lookups
body:
### What this PR does / why we need it?

This PR optimizes the DeepSeek V4.1 DSpark context path in two areas:

1. **Merge context WKV projections**  
   Replace the per-layer WKV projections with one `MergedColumnParallelLinear`, then split the output by draft layer. This combines multiple smaller WKV GEMMs over the same context states into one larger GEMM, improving NPU utilization while preserving the per-layer projections used by draft-token forward.

2. **Reuse RoPE lookups**  
   Query the required RoPE tensors once and reuse them across all DSpark context layers.

### Does this PR introduce _any_ user-facing change?

No. This is an internal performance optimization with no changes to public APIs, configuration, or model semantics.

### How was this patch tested?

#### Unit tests

Unit tests cover:

- Loading each layer's WKV parameters into the corresponding merged projection shard.
- Executing the merged WKV projection once and splitting outputs in layer order.
- Reusing one RoPE lookup across context layers.
- Handling missing per-layer context slot mappings.

#### Microbenchmarks

The microbenchmarks isolate the two optimized parts of the context path. They use NPU Graph execution, NPU event timing, ABBA ordering, and the median of repeated measurements on one Ascend 910B rank.

##### WKV projection

Three independent per-layer W4A8 WKV projections are compared with one merged W4A8 projection. The benchmark uses synthetic BF16 context hidden states and real checkpoint WKV weights and scales. RMSNorm, RoPE, and KV-cache insertion are excluded.

| Context tokens | Before (µs) | After (µs) | Latency reduction | Speedup |
|---:|---:|---:|---:|---:|
| 1,024 | 297.27 | 290.99 | 2.1% | 1.02x |
| 16,384 | 1,449.48 | 884.85 | 39.0% | 1.64x |
| 32,768 | 2,943.09 | 1,716.87 | 41.7% | 1.71x |
| 50,000 | 4,416.16 | 2,600.06 | 41.1% | 1.70x |

##### RoPE lookup reuse

Both paths execute the same three rotary kernels. The baseline performs one RoPE lookup per DSpark layer, while the optimized path performs one filtered lookup and reuses the result across all three layers. WKV projection, RMSNorm, and KV-cache insertion are excluded.

| Context tokens | Before (µs) | After (µs) | Latency reduction | Speedup |
|---:|---:|---:|---:|---:|
| 1,024 | 329.17 | 299.84 | 8.9% | 1.10x |
| 16,384 | 1,610.26 | 610.71 | 62.1% | 2.64x |
| 32,768 | 2,931.14 | 1,089.04 | 62.8% | 2.69x |
| 50,000 | 4,352.15 | 1,592.35 | 63.4% | 2.73x |

#### Ascend 910B benchmark

Environment:

- Hardware: 8 × Ascend 910B
- Model: `DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash-1017-w4a8-chiro`
- Quantization: W4A8
- Execution mode: Graph enabled
- Requests: 20
- Input length: 50,000 tokens
- Output length: 350 tokens
- Request rate: 0.3 requests/s
- Identical server and benchmark configurations for baseline and PR

Benchmark command:

```bash
vllm bench serve \
  --host 0.0.0.0 \
  --port 8080 \
  --backend openai-chat \
  --model /data/models/DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash-1017-w4a8-chiro \
  --served-model-name illm \
  --tokenizer /data/models/DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash-1017-w4a8-chiro \
  --percentile-metrics ttft,tpot,itl,e2el \
  --metric-percentiles 50,95,99 \
  --dataset-name prefix_repetition \
  --request-rate 0.3 \
  --num-prompts 20 \
  --endpoint /v1/chat/completions \
  --ignore-eos \
  --temperature 0 \
  --seed 8080 \
  --prefix-repetition-prefix-len 45000 \
  --prefix-repetition-suffix-len 5000 \
  --prefix-repetition-output-len 350 \
  --prefix-repetition-num-prefixes 1
```

Results:

| Metric | Baseline | PR | Change |
| --- | ---: | ---: | ---: |
| Successful requests | 20 | 20 | No failures |
| Benchmark duration | 74.22 s | 73.59 s | -0.85% |
| Output throughput | 94.31 tok/s | 95.12 tok/s | +0.86% |
| Total token throughput | 13,575.06 tok/s | 13,692.49 tok/s | +0.87% |
| Mean TTFT | 2,182.98 ms | 2,152.01 ms | -1.42% |
| Median TTFT | 1,248.98 ms | 1,229.78 ms | -1.54% |
| P95 TTFT | 6,352.30 ms | 6,339.67 ms | -0.20% |
| P99 TTFT | 7,283.83 ms | 7,270.61 ms | -0.18% |
| Mean TPOT | 22.55 ms | 22.07 ms | -2.13% |
| Median TPOT | 23.08 ms | 22.31 ms | -3.34% |
| Mean E2EL | 10,054.64 ms | 9,852.71 ms | -2.01% |
| Median E2EL | 9,640.17 ms | 9,486.97 ms | -1.59% |
| DSpark acceptance rate | 29.39% | 30.44% | +1.05 pp |
| DSpark acceptance length | 2.47 | 2.52 | +0.05 |

The PR improves token throughput and reduces TTFT, TPOT, and end-to-end latency without regressing DSpark acceptance metrics.

---

### Checklist

#### Testing

- [x] **Boundary / edge-case coverage**: Missing per-layer context slot mappings are covered.
- [ ] **Regression test**: Not applicable; this is a performance optimization.
- [ ] **Error / failure path coverage**: No new external failure path is introduced.
- [x] **Meaningful & reliable tests**: Tests verify weight routing, projection count, output ordering, and RoPE reuse.
- [x] **Performance impact**: Ascend 910B microbenchmark and serving benchmark results are included above.
